verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents a customizable chart of accounts in its double-entry accounting product, and says an accountant can update it, which covers the core of the story. The pack does not show the specific elements the story names: account types, sub-account hierarchies, or class/tag dimensions. The Get Accounts API only confirms that accounts exist. Missing for 10: documented account-type configuration, sub-account nesting, class or tag dimensions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how deep the customization goes.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions

citations.quote: update your customizable chart of accounts
Your accountant will be able to update your journal entries and chart of accounts
Before creating a journal entry you will need to query the Get Accounts endpoint. This will return an array of accounts.
